correctness.rationale: The 81-state de Bruijn transfer represents TPRDF constraints exactly. Bellman-Ford yields integral nonnegative reduced costs; zero-cost SCCs are simple 3- and 6-cycles; one-cost returns have only length 5 modulo 6. The determinant-trace identity shows D(t)^(d+1) Phi_d(t) is polynomial of degree at most 81d+9 for d=0,1,2,4; verifying lengths 1..345 proves the explicit rational coefficient identities for all n. Independent direct ternary exhaustive enumeration of C_n square K2 for 3<=n<=7 matches all minima and multiplicities. Both packaged programs were compiled and run.
